_about: CAN project segments. One entry per segment page. Row terms and eligibility come from the Notion OFFER TRACKING page (pulled 2026-09-09). Dollar figures are NOT stored here: scripts/segments.py reads them from the tracker parse and writes segments-live.json. Partner names must match the n field in cansw-data.json. count:false = shown, never enters the segment total. stage = which business stages may see the row (omit for all). trophy:false suppresses the trophy for that partner on these pages. every_creator_strip is a ranked list: the page shows the first every_creator_show names not already on that page (biggest brands first, Avi 2026-09-10). events are shown full width on every page as Upcoming events, never counted.
